title: Zulay Kitchen Conical Espresso Burr Coffee Grinder - Touchscreen, 51 Bean Grind Settings, Precision Electric Timer, Stainless Steel - Includes Metal Scooper & 2 Cleaning Brushes
description:
About this item
FRESH GROUND COFFEE ON DEMAND: This espresso grinder turns whole beans to smooth coffee powder with a simple touch. Within seconds, you can make the most flavorful cup of espresso with precisely ground coffee with this burr grinder.
PRECISE TIMER & CUP SETTINGS: With our coffee grinder, get the consistent dose every time by adjusting the grind time with 0.1s increments - selecting between 1 to 60 seconds. When using this coffee grinder espresso, the cup number can also be selected, from 1 to 12 cups.
CHOOSE FROM 51 GRIND SETTINGS: This burr coffee grinder is designed with a conical burr grinder that operates at a low speed to minimize heat and help release the oils for optimal flavor. With our espresso coffee grinder’s 51 adjustable settings, create your perfect cup – from Espresso finesse to French press coarseness!
LARGE BEAN HOPPER: Our espresso bean grinder comes with a 12.5 oz coffee bean hopper, designed with a locking system that ensures safe operation. When using this commercial coffee grinder, collect the coffee directly into a portafilter using the included 53mm/58mm cradles (portafilter not included). When using our coffee grinders, use the dosing rings to avoid any messes.
ANTI-STATIC TECHNOLOGY: This coffee bean grinder is designed to revolutionize the grinding experience. The anti-static technology of our coffee grinders for home use prevent the grounds from sticking to the coffee chamber and creating a mess. This coffee burr grinder allows a smooth flow of coffee grounds for an improved experience.
PREMIUM QUALITY: The bean hopper and coffee ground container of our coffee grinder electric are UV tinted to ensure long-lasting taste and quality of the coffee grinds. The stainless steel conical grinder and all other parts are designed to provide durability for long-term use. Our espresso grinder has a quiet operation for a smooth experience.
EASY TO CLEAN: Our conical burr coffee grinder comes with a coffee grounds residual cleaner; simply replace the bean hopper lid and press it down to remove any leftover grounds. Use the included cleaning brushes for the removable burr grinder and hopper.
HASSLE-FREE, ZULAY GUARANTEE: We are a family owned USA business that believes in providing customers with the best quality products. If there are any issues with the espresso grinder, contact us, and we will always make it right.

reviews_5s:
Now this is a grinder that takes care of all of my coffee grinding needs! The grind is very adjustable. The volume of coffee can be controlled by either using a cup or timed setting. It has been very reliable. I would highly recommend this grinder versus the others.Just perfect for espresso grind. User friendly. No need to spend a lot money on other grinders, when this machine perfectly does the job. This is my at home grinder, paired up with a HiBrew H10A. 100% recommended.Click to play video
My old coffee grinder would not grind coffee fine enough for espresso anymore. So I was searching for a new grinder. For what it does the price is excellent. I was considering higher end grinders but decided to give this one a try. If it doesn’t work as expected I could always return it. I’m glad I did and saved a couple of hundred dollars.
The grinds on the left are for my espresso and the ones on the right for my Techniworm Moccamaster. The grinder comes with many extras. There are two size dosing rings, 53mm & 58mm for your portafilter. A 53mm & 58 mm cradle that holds your portafilter for dosing directly into it. Cleaning brushes, a metal scoop and a container with a silicone cover for dispensing the coffee for your coffee machine, whether it’s a drip, pour over, French press, Aero Press or cold brew. The machine is very quiet compared to my other one. Also no static and no coffee grounds flying all over the place.

The best extra included is the bellows. After grinding coffee there is always coffee grounds in the shoot. Put the bellows (coffee grounds residue cleaner) on top of the bean hopper, put the lid on and pump it a few times and watch all the excess grounds come out. A lot of high end grinders don’t include the bellows and you will have to purchase them separately.

My portafilters ribs were too thick so I couldn’t use the dosing ring that came with it or the metal dosing ring that I have. However the way it disperses grounds into the portafilter I really don’t need it. I just have to fill it, level it up and fill it up again till I have the correct amount of grounds.

You can set it grind 1cup up to 12 cups. You can also set it to time mode 10-60 seconds. There is also a pulse mode when you are using the portafilter.

On the finest settings my coffee grounds were very fine like powder. The one in the photo was set at 5 and made a very good cup of espresso.

Removing the bean hopper and the upper burr is the simplest thing I have ever done. Very easy to clean compared to other grinders I have used.

Don’t let the price scare you away. Give it a try and if you don’t like it you can always send it back. Chances are you’ll keep it because it is a great inexpensive coffee grinder.We make several types of coffee in our home: espresso, pour overs, French press. This grinder is perfect for any cup. You can grind per serving or per seconds. Lots of options for single serving espresso porta filter or into cup for multiple cups of coffee.
Machine quiet and durable.Click to play video
When i was looking for a grinder for my espresso machine I ran across with this guy here! At first I was really skeptical due to how low the price is. Cause in the past I've bought ginders around this price range with poor results!
But this this one i can confidently say this is a incredible Grinder! Being a barista on a budget for my home set up it does the job! I received great results pulling shots of espresso!
It's been a few days now and so far going well! I'll do an update if this were to chance with it!

Note I am using a non pressurized portafilter.Update:
I contacted the company correctly and they were very helpful and quick in replacing the product! New grinder has been working great, likely we received a defective item. Would recommend off of the company’s customer service alone!
We’ve had this coffee grinder for a couple of months and it’s stopped working. We took it apart, cleaned all the parts, put it back together and still not working.This is an awesome grinder...first of all...I'm no barista...just an old veteran that just wants a good latte in the morning...the old grinder I was using was almost four years old...and just couldn't grind fine enough anymore....I searched Amazon, and found this grinder...after using it for the first time, I could really taste a difference in the taste of my latte. The grind settings are adjustable, with 51 grind sizes...I chose number 3 on the espresso settings, and the grind was perfect for my machine....the pucks came out dry & intact...I don't know about the other grind settings as I only make lattes. You can't go wrong with this grinder if you're a coffee lover!Unbelievable! I had been using a grinder with a blade that spins around, not a burr grinder. This grinder makes my espresso taste twice as good! I'm not kidding. I was very surprised. It is a great little machine. (Well, I've only had it for a day and four espressos.) It has great features. And you feel like a professional, inserting the portafilter and having grounds dispensed into it in the portion size and grind that you chose. So much easier than what I was doing before. And soooo much better. Highly recommended. Update: A few days later, it's still awesome and I should have mentioned that it is quiet--with my old grinder, I wore noise-reducing headphones--and anti-static. I have another burr grinder that I never use because it is so staticy and otherwise crappy. I love this grinder. (Okay, they say online that it's professional, but it says in the instructions that it's for home use. Interestingly, no mention anywhere on the packaging or instructions where it's made.)

After having used it for a month, I still love this grinder because it makes my coffee better. But I have found one quirk about it: Using the portafilter cradle, all you have to do is press the portafilter to the back of the cradle and grinding starts automatically. However this can be a little messy, so a dosing ring has been supplied. The instructions say to use the dosing ring when grinding directly into a portafilter. HOWEVER, when using the dosing ring you have to push the start button to start grinding! Oh well, it's still a great grinder, especially for the price.People usually review coffee grinders for how well they grind the beans or other things related to their function. And while this grinder does all of those things and does them very well, there's something about the way this grinder sounds that is so satisfying. It's an odd thing to even care about but it really bumps this thing up to that fifth star in my opinion.

But just to add some opinions on the performance so that this review is actually useful, this thing basically goes all the way down to grinding fine enough that you could do Turkish coffee with it. And the non-static claim about the catch bin is surprisingly accurate. Here's what it looked like after two cups worth of grounds and a simple swish, poor to clean it out.I've had this about a month and used it daily for either espresso or drip coffee and it works and great! My biggest complaint is the mess that it makes. It is so staticy that the front is always covered with grounds and while it is grinding, it will make a mess around it but other than that it is a great product! Nice evenly ground beans and smooth operation.
reviews_1s: I received this item 3 months ago, and whenever I used it to grind our coffee beans it was working perfect. We have not use it as much since our business just started online. When I tried to grind my coffee and put it on espresso option, I started to smell like the wire is burning and I saw smoke coming out so I stopped it and unplugged the grinder. I waited about 2 minutes and plugged it again then turned it on to grind the beans one more time then started smoking again.We are very disappointed in this machine due to the fact that it sticks continuously. It worked fine initially but now each and every time we use it we have to take it apart and clean it out before we could use it again! It is worthless and time consuming. This machine holds a lot of coffee inside the mechanism, there is a lot of coffee wasted using this machine.For three weeks it worked well. Made a very finely ground expresso. Then it just stopped grinding... I took it apart to clean, everything appears good from what I can tell with my limited knowledge of the machine. I put the beans in and it makes a whirring noise like it is grinding, but it doesn't grind at all anymore.I had a few questions for them about this product,sometimes it stops grinding the beans half way through a grind and the anti-static does not work at all tried to contact them ,it says they were to busy to leave a message and they would get back to me but guess what total silence for a week not coolI really liked the grinder up to the moment it broke after just one year. It just stopped working. Everything is blinking , so I assume the mother board is defect. The manual doesn't has any trouble shooting or explanation for any defect. I cleaned the machine, reset it by disconnecting it from the power - no effect. There is no help on the Mueller Home page either. I have to say I am disappointed in the brand.Me había encantado pero 2 meses y ya funcionó, ya no mueleIt worked for the first use. The next day when we tried to use it, the spout that grounds fall into the container was clogged. I used the provided brush to clean out also removed all the beans and looked at the burrs to see that the grounds had backed up into the burrs so no more beans were coming down into the grinder from the hopper. I cleaned it all up and it worked for about 4 seconds before it clogged up again in the same way. I just cleaned it up again, put it back in the box and returned it.Arrived used and dirty. Rather filthy, it had used beens all over and it didn't work. Had to return it.Never turned on because it has an e1 (missing hopper code). I tried manually pressing the switch and still nothing. Seller doesn't care either so don't waste your money and go elsewhere.
